```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(scales)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

if (requireNamespace("TARegEco", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(TARegEco)
} else {
  devtools::load_all(".")
}

# Ekstrak parameter
result_scenario  <- params$result_scenario
result_bau       <- params$result_bau
recap_scenario   <- params$recap_scenario
recap_bau        <- params$recap_bau
indicator_labels <- params$indicator_labels
sector_names     <- params$sector_names
years            <- params$years
active_assumptions <- params$assumption_active

# ---- Flag: apakah ada skenario (A1/A2/A3) atau hanya BAU? ----
is_scenario <- any(c("A1", "A2", "A3") %in% active_assumptions)

# Satuan Rupiah mengikuti params$unit
satuan_uang <- if (!is.null(params$unit) && nzchar(as.character(params$unit)) && 
                   !is.na(params$unit) && params$unit != "NA") {
  as.character(params$unit)
} else {
  "Rp Juta"  # fallback
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: format dinamis satuan mata uang (input diasumsikan Juta)
#   - x >= 1e6  -> "Triliun"
#   - x >= 1e3  -> "Miliar"
#   - selainnya -> "Juta"
# Catatan: label satuan kata (Juta/Miliar/Triliun) tetap generik
# karena params$unit hanya mendeskripsikan satuan dasar (mis. "Rp").
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Kolom indikator yang bersatuan uang (input diasumsikan Juta)
money_cols <- c("GDP", "INCOME", "INCOME_PER_CAPITA", "SURPLUS", "OUTPUT")

# Helper: apakah suatu kolom indikator bersatuan uang?
is_money <- function(col) col %in% money_cols

# Format dinamis: hanya suffix skala (Juta/Miliar/Triliun).
# Prefix satuan (mis. "Rp") TIDAK ditampilkan karena nama kolom
# sudah mencantumkan satuan.
# Argumen `satuan` dipertahankan untuk kompatibilitas pemanggil lama,
# tetapi tidak dipakai di output.
format_uang <- function(x, satuan = satuan_uang) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "-",
    ifelse(x == 0, "0",
      ifelse(x >= 1e6,
        paste0(format(round(x / 1e6, 2), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".", nsmall = 2), " Triliun"),
      ifelse(x >= 1e3,
        paste0(format(round(x / 1e3, 2), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".", nsmall = 2), " Miliar"),
        paste0(format(round(x, 2), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".", nsmall = 2), " Juta"))))
  )
}

# Agregasi by year:
# - Kolom biasa (GDP, LABOUR, dll) → di-SUM antar sektor
# - Kolom per kapita (INCOME_PER_CAPITA) → diambil nilai unik per tahun (first)
agg_by_year <- function(df, col) {
  # ---- Deteksi kolom tahun secara fleksibel ----
  year_col <- NULL
  for (cand in c("YEAR", "year", "Year", "Tahun", "tahun", "PERIODE", "periode")) {
    if (cand %in% names(df)) {
      year_col <- cand
      break
    }
  }
  if (is.null(year_col)) {
    stop(
      "[agg_by_year] Kolom tahun tidak ditemukan. Kolom tersedia: ",
      paste(names(df), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # ---- Normalisasi: rename kolom tahun ke 'YEAR' dan konversi ke numerik ----
  if (year_col != "YEAR") {
    df <- df |> dplyr::rename(YEAR = dplyr::all_of(year_col))
  }
  df$YEAR <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$YEAR))
  
  # ---- Agregasi ----
  is_constant_per_year <- col %in% c("GDP_PER_CAPITA", "INCOME_PER_CAPITA")
  
  if (is_constant_per_year) {
    df |> dplyr::group_by(YEAR) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        Total = dplyr::first(.data[[col]]),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    df |> dplyr::group_by(YEAR) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        Total = sum(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
}

# Siapkan seri per indikator — hanya BAU jika tidak ada skenario
build_series <- function(col) {
  b <- agg_by_year(result_bau, col) |> dplyr::mutate(Seri = "BAU")
  if (!is_scenario) return(b)
  s <- agg_by_year(result_scenario, col) |> dplyr::mutate(Seri = "Intervensi")
  dplyr::bind_rows(b, s)
}

# Helper: bikin tabel rekapitulasi per indikator
build_recap_table <- function(col, label) {
  b <- agg_by_year(result_bau, col) |> dplyr::rename(BAU = Total)

  if (!is_scenario) {
    return(b |> dplyr::rename(Tahun = YEAR))
  }

  s <- agg_by_year(result_scenario, col) |> dplyr::rename(Skenario = Total)

  dplyr::left_join(b, s, by = "YEAR") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Selisih_Pct = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(BAU) | is.na(Skenario) | BAU == 0,
        NA_real_,
        (Skenario / BAU - 1) * 100
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      Tahun          = YEAR,
      `Selisih (%)`  = Selisih_Pct
    )
}

build_plot <- function(col, label) {
  d <- build_series(col)
  d$Seri <- factor(d$Seri, levels = c("BAU", "Intervensi"))

  unit <- if (exists("ind_units") && col %in% names(ind_units)) ind_units[[col]] else ""

  y_title <- if (nzchar(unit)) paste0(label, " (", unit, ")") else label

  # Format nilai untuk tooltip: dinamis untuk indikator uang
   nilai_txt <- if (is_money(col)) {
    format_uang(d$Total, satuan = satuan_uang)
  } else {
    paste0(scales::comma(d$Total, accuracy = 1), if (nzchar(unit)) paste0(" ", unit) else "")
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    d,
    aes(
      x = YEAR, y = Total, color = Seri, group = Seri,
      text = paste0(
        "Tahun: ", YEAR,
        "<br>Seri: ", Seri,
        "<br>Nilai: ", nilai_txt
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = unique(d$YEAR),
      labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = "", scientific = FALSE)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste("Proyeksi", label), x = "Tahun", y = y_title, color = NULL)
  
  # Di build_plot: penyesuaian scale_color_manual
if (is_scenario) {
  p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = c("BAU" = "#7f8c8d", "Intervensi" = "#27ae60"))
} else {
  p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = c("BAU" = "#7f8c8d"))
}

  plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
}

# Mapping: kolom → label (digunakan untuk iterasi)
ind_cols   <- c("GDP", "LABOUR", "INCOME", "INCOME_PER_CAPITA", "SURPLUS", "OUTPUT")
ind_titles <- c(
  "GDP"                = "Proyeksi PDRB",
  "LABOUR"             = "Proyeksi Serapan Tenaga Kerja",
  "INCOME"             = "Proyeksi Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja",
  "INCOME_PER_CAPITA"  = "Proyeksi Pendapatan per Kapita",
  "SURPLUS"            = "Proyeksi Surplus Usaha Bruto",
  "OUTPUT"             = "Proyeksi Output Total"
)

ind_units  <- c(
  "GDP"                = paste0(satuan_uang, "/Tahun"),
  "LABOUR"             = "Orang/Tahun",
  "INCOME"             = paste0(satuan_uang, "/Tahun"),
  "INCOME_PER_CAPITA"  = paste0(satuan_uang, "/Orang"),
  "SURPLUS"            = paste0(satuan_uang, "/Tahun"),
  "OUTPUT"             = paste0(satuan_uang, "/Tahun")
)

has_a3 <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: tambahkan kolom "Pertumbuhan per Tahun" dengan bar HTML
# yang mendukung nilai negatif.
#   - Positif: bar ke kanan, warna `color_pos` (default biru)
#   - Negatif: bar ke kiri, warna `color_neg` (default merah)
#   - Lebar bar dinormalisasi terhadap |CAGR| maksimum
# Input:
#   - df: data frame dengan kolom `Pertumbuhan (%)` (CAGR dalam persen)
#   - color_pos: warna bar positif (default "#4A90E2")
#   - color_neg: warna bar negatif (default "#e74c3c")
# Output:
#   - df tanpa kolom `Pertumbuhan (%)`, dengan kolom baru
#     `Pertumbuhan per Tahun` berupa HTML bar
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
add_growth_bar <- function(df,
                           color = "#4A90E2",
                           neg_color = "#e74c3c") {
  if (!"Pertumbuhan (%)" %in% names(df)) return(df)

  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      .cagr      = dplyr::coalesce(.data[["Pertumbuhan (%)"]], 0),
      .max_abs   = suppressWarnings(max(abs(.cagr), na.rm = TRUE)),
      .is_neg    = .cagr < 0,
      .bar_width = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(.max_abs) | .max_abs == 0 | is.infinite(.max_abs),
        0,
        pmax(0, pmin(100, abs(.cagr) / .max_abs * 100))
      ),
      .bar_color = dplyr::if_else(.is_neg, neg_color, color),
      .bar_align = dplyr::if_else(
        .is_neg,
        "margin-left:auto;",
        "margin-right:auto; margin-left:0;"
      ),
      .label_txt = dplyr::if_else(
        .is_neg,
        sprintf("%.2f%%", .cagr),
        sprintf("+%.2f%%", .cagr)
      ),
      .label_color = dplyr::if_else(.is_neg, neg_color, "#666666"),
      `Pertumbuhan per Tahun` = sprintf(
        '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
           <div style="flex:1; position:relative; background:#eee; height:14px; border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;">
             <div style="position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; left:50%%; width:1px; background:#ccc;"></div>
             <div style="position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; %s width:%.1f%%; background:%s; border-radius:3px;"></div>
           </div>
           <span style="font-size:11px; color:%s; min-width:70px; text-align:right;">%s</span>
         </div>',
        .bar_align,
        .bar_width,
        .bar_color,
        .label_color,
        .label_txt
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(-.cagr, -.max_abs, -.is_neg, -.bar_width,
                  -.bar_color, -.bar_align, -.label_txt, -.label_color,
                  -`Pertumbuhan (%)`)

  df
}
```

```{r analysis-log, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helper untuk mengamankan nilai NULL / character(0) agar tidak merusak tribble
safe_str <- function(val, default = "-") {
  if (is.null(val) || length(val) == 0 || is.na(val) || val == "" || val == "NA") {
    return(default)
  }
  return(as.character(val))
}

# Helper: gunakan nama file asli, fallback ke basename(path), lalu default
safe_filename <- function(name_val, path_val, default = "-") {
  # Prioritas 1: nama file asli dari input$file$name
  if (!is.null(name_val) && length(name_val) > 0 &&
      !is.na(name_val) && nzchar(as.character(name_val)) &&
      as.character(name_val) != "NA") {
    return(as.character(name_val))
  }
  # Prioritas 2: basename dari path (jika path valid & bukan temp)
  if (!is.null(path_val) && length(path_val) > 0 &&
      !is.na(path_val) && nzchar(as.character(path_val)) &&
      as.character(path_val) != "NA") {
    bn <- basename(as.character(path_val))
    # Jika basename berupa angka/nomor temp (mis. "0.xlsx", "1.xlsx"), anggap tidak valid
    if (!grepl("^\\d+\\.(xlsx?|rds|csv)$", bn, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      return(bn)
    }
  }
  default
}

# --- Siapkan daftar file input (nama file asli, bukan path temp) ---
input_files <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Kategori,                     ~Keterangan,
  "Baseline (Deskriptif)",       safe_filename(params$file_baseline_name, params$file_baseline),
  "Proyeksi Lahan BAU",          safe_filename(params$file_bau_name,      params$file_bau),
  "Asumsi 1: Perubahan Lahan",   safe_filename(params$file_a1_name,       params$file_a1, "(tidak dipakai)"),
  "Asumsi 2: Produktivitas LPC", safe_filename(params$file_a2_name,       params$file_a2, "(tidak dipakai)"),
  "Asumsi 3: Hilirisasi",        safe_filename(params$file_a3_name,       params$file_a3, "(tidak dipakai)")
)

# --- Log utama ---
analysis_log <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Kategori,               ~Keterangan,
  "Waktu Mulai Analisis",  safe_str(params$start_time),
  "Waktu Selesai Analisis", safe_str(params$end_time),
  "Skenario",              safe_str(params$scenario_name),
  "Asumsi Aktif",          if (length(active_assumptions) > 0) paste(active_assumptions, collapse = " + ") else "-",
  "Tahun Awal",            safe_str(params$initial_year),
  "Tahun Akhir",           safe_str(params$end_year),
  "Interval",              paste0(safe_str(params$time_step), " tahun"),
  "Lokasi",                safe_str(params$location),
  "Satuan",                safe_str(params$unit),
  "Direktori Output",      safe_str(params$output_dir)
)

# --- Gabungkan ---
analysis_log_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  analysis_log,
  tibble::tibble(Kategori = "--- Data Input ---", Keterangan = ""),
  input_files
)

analysis_log_full %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_paper("hover", full_width = FALSE) %>%
```

# Pendahuluan

Laporan ini menyajikan hasil proyeksi ekonomi regional dengan skenario intervensi. Proyeksi dilakukan menggunakan model **Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output** (Hubacek & Sun, 2001) yang menggabungkan tabel Input-Output regional dengan batasan kapasitas lahan untuk menghasilkan estimasi indikator makroekonomi yang konsisten. 

Tabel berikut merangkum profil analisis yang digunakan dalam laporan ini.

```{r pendahuluan-profil, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helper: amankan nilai
safe_val <- function(x, default = "-") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x)) ||
      identical(as.character(x), "NA") || !nzchar(as.character(x))) {
    return(default)
  }
  as.character(x)
}

# Ringkasan profil
```

```{r asumsi-profil, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
descriptions <- c(
```

## Catatan Metodologi

Laporan ini menyajikan hasil proyeksi ekonomi regional menggunakan model **Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output** (Hubacek & Sun, 2001). Model ini menggabungkan tabel Input-Output regional dengan **batasan kapasitas lahan** — perubahan tutupan lahan (Asumsi 1), peningkatan produktivitas lahan (Asumsi 2), dan restrukturisasi struktur ekonomi (Asumsi 3) — untuk menghasilkan proyeksi indikator makroekonomi yang konsisten dengan ketersediaan sumber daya lahan.

```{r pendahuluan-metodologi-note, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
)
```

## Proyeksi Lahan BAU

```{r input-BAU, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
file_path_bau <- params$file_bau

if (!is.null(file_path_bau) && file.exists(as.character(file_path_bau))) {
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_bau)
  target_sheet <- if ("luc_projection" %in% sheets) "luc_projection" else sheets[1]
  
  df_bau <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_bau, sheet = target_sheet)
  
  df_bau <- df_bau |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ {
    # Coba konversi
    num_conv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
    
    # Jumlah NA sebelum & sesudah konversi
    n_na_before <- sum(is.na(.))
    n_na_after  <- sum(is.na(num_conv))
    
    # Kalau tidak ada NA baru (semua nilai berhasil dikonversi),
    # pakai numerik. Kalau ada NA baru (kolom berisi teks), tetap teks.
    if (n_na_after <= n_na_before) num_conv else as.character(.)
  }))
  
  all_num_cols <- names(df_bau)[sapply(df_bau, is.numeric)]
  num_cols_to_format <- setdiff(all_num_cols, c("ID", "id", "Id"))
  
  if (length(num_cols_to_format) > 0) {
    df_bau <- df_bau |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(num_cols_to_format), ~ round(., 2)))
  }
  
  dt <- DT::datatable(
    df_bau,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("Tabel Proyeksi Luas Lahan BAU (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  if (length(num_cols_to_format) > 0) {
    dt <- dt |> DT::formatRound(columns = num_cols_to_format, digits = 2, mark = ",")
  }
  
  dt
} else {
  render_notice("File data input Proyeksi Lahan BAU tidak ditemukan atau path file tidak valid.")
}
```

```{r input-A1-A3-dynamic, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# ============================================================
# Render tab Asumsi 1/2/3 secara dinamis, hanya jika file valid
# ============================================================
# Helper: cek file valid
is_valid_file <- function(path) {
  !is.null(path) && length(path) > 0 &&
    !is.na(path) && nzchar(as.character(path)) &&
    file.exists(as.character(path))
}

# Helper: render DataTable + tabel jadi HTML string
render_dt_to_html <- function(dt_obj) {
  html_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
  htmltools::save_html(dt_obj, file = html_file)
  paste(readLines(html_file, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}

# Helper: buat DT dengan format numerik 2 desimal
create_dt <- function(df, caption_text, exclude_cols = c("ID", "id", "Id")) {
  # Konversi otomatis: hanya kolom yang SELURUH nilainya bisa jadi numerik
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), ~ {
      chr         <- as.character(.)
      num_conv    <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(chr))
      n_na_before <- sum(is.na(chr))
      n_na_after  <- sum(is.na(num_conv))
      # Kalau tidak ada NA baru → semua nilai berhasil dikonversi → pakai numerik
      if (n_na_after <= n_na_before) num_conv else chr
    }))
  
  all_num_cols <- names(df)[sapply(df, is.numeric)]
  num_cols     <- setdiff(all_num_cols, exclude_cols)
  
  if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(num_cols), ~ round(., 2)))
  }
  
  dt <- DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = caption_text,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
    dt <- dt |> DT::formatRound(columns = num_cols, digits = 2, mark = ",")
  }
  
  list(dt = dt, num_cols = num_cols, df = df)
}

# ============================================================
# ASUMSI 1: Perubahan Lahan
# ============================================================
has_a1       <- "A1" %in% active_assumptions
file_path_a1 <- params$file_a1

if (has_a1 && is_valid_file(file_path_a1)) {
  cat("\n\n## Asumsi 1: Perubahan Lahan\n\n")

  sheets       <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_a1)
  has_land     <- "land_proportion" %in% sheets
  target_sheet <- if ("luc_projection" %in% sheets) "luc_projection" else sheets[1]

  # --- Tabel 1: luc_projection ---
  cat(paste0("\n\n### Tabel Luas Lahan (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")\n\n"))

  df_a1  <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a1, sheet = target_sheet)
  res_a1 <- create_dt(
    df_a1,
    paste0("Tabel Asumsi 1: Perubahan Luas Lahan (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")")
  )
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(res_a1$dt)))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Tabel 2: land_proportion (jika ada) ---
  if (has_land) {
    cat("\n\n### Tabel Proporsi Lahan (Sheet: land_proportion)\n\n")

    df_land  <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a1, sheet = "land_proportion")
    res_land <- create_dt(
      df_land,
      "Tabel Asumsi 1: Proporsi Lahan (Sheet: land_proportion)"
    )
    cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(res_land$dt)))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

# ============================================================
# ASUMSI 2: Produktivitas LPC
# ============================================================
has_a2      <- "A2" %in% active_assumptions
file_path_a2 <- params$file_a2

if (has_a2 && is_valid_file(file_path_a2)) {
  cat("\n\n## Asumsi 2: Produktivitas LPC\n\n")
  
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_a2)
  
  if ("Skenario_LPC" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "Skenario_LPC"
    skip_rows <- 11
  } else if ("produktivitas_lpc" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "produktivitas_lpc"
    skip_rows <- 0
  } else if ("lpc" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "lpc"
    skip_rows <- 0
  } else {
    target_sheet <- sheets[1]
    skip_rows <- 0
  }
  
  df_a2 <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a2, sheet = target_sheet, skip = skip_rows)
  res_a2 <- create_dt(
    df_a2,
    paste0("Tabel Asumsi 2: Target Produktivitas LPC (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"),
    exclude_cols = c("ID", "id", "Id", "KODE", "Kode", "NO", "No")
  )
  
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(res_a2$dt)))
  cat("\n\n")
}

# ============================================================
# ASUMSI 3: Hilirisasi
# ============================================================
has_a3      <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions
file_path_a3 <- params$file_a3

if (has_a3 && is_valid_file(file_path_a3)) {
  cat("\n\n## Asumsi 3: Hilirisasi\n\n")
  
  sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(file_path_a3)
  
  if ("Restrukturisasi" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "Restrukturisasi"
    skip_rows <- 11
  } else if ("Skenario_4_Restrukturisasi" %in% sheets) {
    target_sheet <- "Skenario_4_Restrukturisasi"
    skip_rows <- 11
  } else {
    target_sheet <- sheets[1]
    skip_rows <- 0
  }
  
  df_a3 <- readxl::read_excel(file_path_a3, sheet = target_sheet, skip = skip_rows)
  
  col_from <- names(df_a3)[grep("SEKTOR ASAL|FROM SECTOR", names(df_a3), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  col_to   <- names(df_a3)[grep("SEKTOR TUJUAN|TO SECTOR", names(df_a3), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  
  if (!is.na(col_from)) {
    df_a3 <- df_a3 |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[col_from]])) |>
      dplyr::mutate(.data[[col_from]] := trimws(.data[[col_from]]))
  }
  if (!is.na(col_to)) {
    df_a3 <- df_a3 |>
      dplyr::mutate(.data[[col_to]] := trimws(.data[[col_to]]))
  }
  
  dt_a3 <- DT::datatable(
    df_a3,
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = paste0("Tabel Asumsi 3: Restrukturisasi Tabel I-O (Sheet: ", target_sheet, ")"),
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 10,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(dt_a3)))
  cat("\n\n")
}

# ============================================================
# Fallback: jika tidak ada asumsi yang diaktifkan
# ============================================================
if (!(has_a1 && is_valid_file(file_path_a1)) &&
    !(has_a2 && is_valid_file(file_path_a2)) &&
    !(has_a3 && is_valid_file(file_path_a3))) {
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(
    render_notice("Tidak ada file Asumsi 1/2/3 yang diinput. Hanya Baseline BAU yang ditampilkan.")
  )))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Ringkasan

```{r summary-table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# ---- 0. Satuan tampilan: params$unit TANPA kata "Juta" ----
satuan_dasar <- if (!is.null(params$unit) && nzchar(as.character(params$unit)) &&
                    !is.na(params$unit) && params$unit != "NA") {
  u <- as.character(params$unit)
  trimws(gsub("\\s*Juta\\s*", " ", u, ignore.case = TRUE))
} else {
  "Rp"
}

# ---- 0b. Nama kolom dinamis: "Nilai <initial_year>" & "Nilai <end_year>" ----
# Fallback ke "Nilai Awal"/"Nilai Akhir" jika tahun NA
col_nilai_awal  <- if (!is.null(params$initial_year) && !is.na(params$initial_year)) {
  paste0("Nilai ", params$initial_year)
} else {
  "Nilai Awal"
}
col_nilai_akhir <- if (!is.null(params$end_year) && !is.na(params$end_year)) {
  paste0("Nilai ", params$end_year)
} else {
  "Nilai Akhir"
}

# ---- 1. Fungsi bantu: ringkasan per indikator ----
summary_row <- function(df, col, label, unit) {
  d <- agg_by_year(df, col)

  nilai_awal  <- d$Total[1]
  nilai_akhir <- d$Total[nrow(d)]
  tahun_awal  <- d$YEAR[1]
  tahun_akhir <- d$YEAR[nrow(d)]
  n_year      <- max(1, tahun_akhir - tahun_awal)

  # Buat tibble dengan nama kolom dinamis via setNames
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    Indikator         = label,
    Satuan            = unit,
    nilai_awal_val    = nilai_awal,
    nilai_akhir_val   = nilai_akhir,
    n_tahun           = n_year,
    `Pertumbuhan (%)` = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(nilai_awal) | nilai_awal == 0,
      NA_real_,
      (nilai_akhir / nilai_awal - 1) * 100
    ),
    `CAGR (%)`        = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(nilai_awal) | nilai_awal <= 0 | is.na(nilai_akhir) | n_year == 0,
      NA_real_,
      ((nilai_akhir / nilai_awal)^(1 / n_year) - 1) * 100
    )
  )

  # Rename kolom nilai_awal_val / nilai_akhir_val secara dinamis
  names(out)[names(out) == "nilai_awal_val"]  <- col_nilai_awal
  names(out)[names(out) == "nilai_akhir_val"] <- col_nilai_akhir
  out
}

# ---- 2. Ringkasan BAU ----
sum_bau <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  ind_cols, seq_along(ind_cols),
  ~ summary_row(result_bau, .x, ind_titles[.x], ind_units[.x])
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Skenario = "BAU")

# ---- 3. Ringkasan Skenario (hanya jika ada) ----
if (is_scenario) {
  sum_sc <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    ind_cols, seq_along(ind_cols),
    ~ summary_row(result_scenario, .x, ind_titles[.x], ind_units[.x])
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Skenario = "Skenario")
  sum_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(sum_bau, sum_sc)
} else {
  sum_all <- sum_bau
}

# ---- 4. Gabungkan, urutkan, petakan satuan ----
sum_all <- sum_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Indikator = factor(Indikator, levels = ind_titles),
    Skenario  = factor(Skenario, levels = c("BAU", "Intervensi"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Indikator, Skenario) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Indikator = as.character(Indikator),
    Skenario  = as.character(Skenario)
  )

ind_label_to_col <- setNames(names(ind_titles), ind_titles)
sum_all$Satuan <- ind_units[ind_label_to_col[sum_all$Indikator]]

sum_all <- sum_all |>
  dplyr::select(
    Indikator, Skenario, Satuan,
    dplyr::all_of(col_nilai_awal),
    dplyr::all_of(col_nilai_akhir),
    `Pertumbuhan (%)`, `CAGR (%)`, n_tahun
  )

# ---- 5. Bar "Pertumbuhan per Tahun" ----
# Jika hanya BAU (1 baris per indikator), bar tetap ditampilkan
# sebagai single-bar referensi; warnanya BAU (biru).
if (is_scenario) {
  sum_all <- sum_all %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Indikator) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      max_cagr   = max(`CAGR (%)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      bar_width  = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(max_cagr) | max_cagr == 0 | is.infinite(max_cagr), 0,
        pmax(0, pmin(100, `CAGR (%)` / max_cagr * 100))
      ),
      bar_color  = ifelse(Skenario == "BAU", "#4A90E2", "#F18F01"),
      `Pertumbuhan per Tahun` = sprintf(
        '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
           <div style="flex:1; background:#eee; height:14px; border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;">
             <div style="width:%.1f%%; background:%s; height:100%%;"></div>
           </div>
           <span style="font-size:11px; color:#666; min-width:70px; text-align:right;">%.2f%%</span>
         </div>',
        bar_width, bar_color, dplyr::coalesce(`CAGR (%)`, 0)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-max_cagr, -bar_width, -bar_color,
                  -`Pertumbuhan (%)`, -`CAGR (%)`, -n_tahun)
} else {
  # Mode BAU-only: bar tunggal dengan warna netral
  sum_all <- sum_all %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bar_width = 100,
      `Pertumbuhan per Tahun` = sprintf(
        '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
           <div style="flex:1; background:#eee; height:14px; border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden;">
             <div style="width:%.1f%%; background:%s; height:100%%;"></div>
           </div>
           <span style="font-size:11px; color:#666; min-width:70px; text-align:right;">%.2f%%</span>
         </div>',
        bar_width, "#7f8c8d", dplyr::coalesce(`CAGR (%)`, 0)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-`Pertumbuhan (%)`, -`CAGR (%)`, -n_tahun, -bar_width)
}

# Kolom Skenario dihapus jika tidak ada skenario
if (!is_scenario) {
  sum_all <- sum_all |> dplyr::select(-Skenario)
}

# ---- 6. Format nilai dengan format_uang() ----
# Untuk indikator bersatuan uang: gunakan format_uang
# Untuk LABOUR: format numerik biasa
sum_disp <- sum_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    !!col_nilai_awal := dplyr::case_when(
      Indikator == ind_titles[["INCOME_PER_CAPITA"]] ~
        paste0(format_uang(.data[[col_nilai_awal]],  satuan_uang)),
      Indikator %in% ind_titles[is_money(ind_cols)] ~
        format_uang(.data[[col_nilai_awal]],  satuan_uang),
      TRUE ~ formatC(.data[[col_nilai_awal]], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
    ),
    !!col_nilai_akhir := dplyr::case_when(
      Indikator == ind_titles[["INCOME_PER_CAPITA"]] ~
        paste0(format_uang(.data[[col_nilai_akhir]], satuan_uang)),
      Indikator %in% ind_titles[is_money(ind_cols)] ~
        format_uang(.data[[col_nilai_akhir]], satuan_uang),
      TRUE ~ formatC(.data[[col_nilai_akhir]], format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
    )
  )

# ---- 7. Render tabel ----
DT::datatable(
  sum_disp,
  rownames   = FALSE,
  escape     = FALSE,
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options    = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    dom        = "Bfrtip",
    buttons    = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
    scrollX    = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(
        targets = which(names(sum_disp) == "Pertumbuhan per Tahun") - 1,
        width   = "200px"
      )
    )
  )
)
```

# Analisis Sektoral {.tabset}

## PDRB per Sektor

```{r sector-pdrb, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pdrb_awal_col  <- paste0("PDRB ", params$initial_year, " (", satuan_uang, ")")
pdrb_akhir_col <- paste0("PDRB ", params$end_year,     " (", satuan_uang, ")")

sector_summary <- result_scenario |>
  dplyr::group_by(SECTOR) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    GDP_Awal  = GDP[YEAR == min(YEAR)],
    GDP_Akhir = GDP[YEAR == max(YEAR)],
    Tahun_Awal  = min(YEAR),
    Tahun_Akhir = max(YEAR),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_tahun = pmax(1, Tahun_Akhir - Tahun_Awal),
    `Pertumbuhan (%)` = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(GDP_Awal) | GDP_Awal <= 0 | is.na(GDP_Akhir),
      NA_real_,
      ((GDP_Akhir / GDP_Awal)^(1 / n_tahun) - 1) * 100
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(`Pertumbuhan (%)`)) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Sektor`                        = SECTOR,
    !!pdrb_awal_col                 := GDP_Awal,
    !!pdrb_akhir_col                := GDP_Akhir
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-Tahun_Awal, -Tahun_Akhir, -n_tahun)

top20 <- head(sector_summary, 20) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    !!pdrb_awal_col  := format_uang(.data[[pdrb_awal_col]],  satuan_uang),
    !!pdrb_akhir_col := format_uang(.data[[pdrb_akhir_col]], satuan_uang)
  ) |>
  add_growth_bar(color = "#4A90E2")

DT::datatable(
  top20,
  rownames   = FALSE,
  escape     = FALSE,
  caption    = paste0(
    "Top 20 Sektor berdasarkan PDRB Akhir (Skenario) — ",
    params$initial_year, " s.d. ", params$end_year
  ),
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options    = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    dom        = "Bfrtip",
    buttons    = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
    scrollX    = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(
        targets = which(names(top20) == "Pertumbuhan per Tahun") - 1,
        width   = "200px"
      )
    )
  )
)
```

```{r linkage-a3, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
has_a3 <- "A3" %in% active_assumptions
lk     <- params$linkage_compare

data_ok <- is.data.frame(lk) && nrow(lk) > 0 &&
  all(c("SECTOR", "ITBL_BEFORE", "ITBL_AFTER", "ITFL_BEFORE", "ITFL_AFTER") %in% names(lk))

if (has_a3 && data_ok) {

  lk$DELTA_ITBL <- lk$ITBL_AFTER - lk$ITBL_BEFORE
  lk$DELTA_ITFL <- lk$ITFL_AFTER - lk$ITFL_BEFORE

  # Grafik interaktif Top-N sektor dengan perubahan terbesar untuk satu indeks
  build_linkage_plot <- function(lk, type, n_top = 15) {
    d <- data.frame(
      Sektor  = lk$SECTOR,
      Sebelum = lk[[paste0(type, "_BEFORE")]],
      Sesudah = lk[[paste0(type, "_AFTER")]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    d$Delta <- d$Sesudah - d$Sebelum
    d <- d[order(-abs(d$Delta)), ][1:min(n_top, nrow(d)), ]

    d_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
      d, cols = c("Sebelum", "Sesudah"),
      names_to = "Status", values_to = "Indeks"
    )
    d_long$Status <- factor(d_long$Status, levels = c("Sebelum", "Sesudah"))

    p <- ggplot(d_long, aes(x = reorder(Sektor, Indeks), y = Indeks, fill = Status)) +
      geom_col(position = "dodge") +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Sebelum = "#bdc3c7", Sesudah = "#27ae60")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Perubahan ", type, " (Top ", nrow(d), ")"),
        x = NULL, y = paste("Indeks", type), fill = NULL
      )

    plotly::ggplotly(p)
  }

  cat("\n\n# Analisis Linkage (Asumsi 3: Hilirisasi) {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n")

  # --- Tab 1: ITBL ---
  cat("\n\n## Grafik ITBL (Backward)\n\n")
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(build_linkage_plot(lk, "ITBL"))))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Tab 2: ITFL ---
  cat("\n\n## Grafik ITFL (Forward)\n\n")
  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(build_linkage_plot(lk, "ITFL"))))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Tab 3: Tabel (semua sektor, ITBL dan ITFL) ---
  cat("\n\n## Tabel Perubahan Linkage\n\n")

  dt_all <- data.frame(
    Sektor         = lk$SECTOR,
    `ITBL Sebelum` = lk$ITBL_BEFORE,
    `ITBL Sesudah` = lk$ITBL_AFTER,
    `ΔITBL`        = lk$DELTA_ITBL,
    `ITFL Sebelum` = lk$ITFL_BEFORE,
    `ITFL Sesudah` = lk$ITFL_AFTER,
    `ΔITFL`        = lk$DELTA_ITFL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  dt_all <- dt_all[order(-pmax(abs(dt_all$`ΔITBL`), abs(dt_all$`ΔITFL`))), ]

  dt_widget <- DT::datatable(
    dt_all,
    rownames   = FALSE,
    caption    = "Perubahan ITBL dan ITFL per Sektor (diurutkan menurut perubahan terbesar)",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options    = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      dom        = "Bfrtip",
      buttons    = c("copy", "excel", "csv"),
      scrollX    = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
    DT::formatRound(
      c("ITBL Sebelum", "ITBL Sesudah", "ΔITBL",
        "ITFL Sebelum", "ITFL Sesudah", "ΔITFL"),
      digits = 4, mark = ","
    )

  cat(as.character(htmltools::tagList(dt_widget)))
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- Catatan interpretasi ---
  cat("Indeks Total Backward Linkage (ITBL) menunjukkan seberapa besar suatu sektor menyerap input dari sektor lain, sedangkan Indeks Total Forward Linkage (ITFL) menunjukkan seberapa besar output suatu sektor dipakai sebagai input oleh sektor lain. Indeks di atas 1 berarti keterkaitan sektor tersebut di atas rata-rata seluruh sektor. Perubahan positif (ΔITBL atau ΔITFL > 0) berarti keterkaitan sektor menguat setelah restrukturisasi tabel I-O, perubahan negatif berarti melemah.\n\n")
}
```
